title: Umrah Travel Arrangements
short: Comprehensive Umrah visa, scheduled flights, and end-to-end journey logistics managed with meticulous care.
description: Performing Umrah is a life-defining journey of the spirit. Iconic Travel & Tours (GL #5247) ensures that every administrative, regulatory, and logistical requirement is handled flawlessly so that your focus remains solely on worship and spiritual elevation.
offerings: Official Saudi Umrah & Tourist visa processing via authorized channels
Competitive air ticketing with leading carriers (Saudia, PIA, Emirates, Qatar Airways)
Pre-departure visa verification and Nusuk platform appointment synchronization
Custom itineraries for individual travelers, couples, and extended families
Dedicated documentation support and baggage allowance facilitation

title: Group Travel Management
short: Structured, dependable group tours led by experienced Pakistani tour directors for community and corporate groups.
description: Drawing from our proven expertise in managing large-scale delegations—such as our featured TECNO Umrah Group Tour 2026 / 1448 AH—Iconic Travel & Tours specializes in precision group movements that maintain individual comfort within organized collective care.
offerings: Experienced group tour coordinators accompanying pilgrims throughout the trip
Structured daily prayer gatherings, Ziyarat departures, and return assemblies
Coordinated luggage check-in, room key pre-distribution, and luggage porterage
Group communication channels for real-time announcements and emergency contacts
Corporate incentives and family group discounts

title: Hotel Support & Luxury Booking
short: Direct partnerships with verified hotels within direct walking distance of the Holy Mosques.
description: Nothing preserves your physical stamina for Ibadah more than immediate proximity to the Haram. We partner with handpicked 5-star and 4-star properties overlooking or steps away from the courtyard, guaranteeing confirmed bookings and prompt room allocations.
offerings: Clock Tower and Abraj Al Bait premier Kaaba-view suites in Makkah
Central Markazia luxury hotels bordering the Prophet's Mosque courtyard in Madinah
24/7 on-ground hotel liaison to assist with room upgrades, housekeeping, and special requests
Interconnecting family suites and wheelchair-accessible rooms
Daily international and oriental breakfast buffets

title: Transportation Support & VIP Fleet
short: Punctual, sanitized air-conditioned transport ranging from private GMC Yukons to luxury group coaches.
description: From your initial arrival at King Abdulaziz International Airport to your intercity transfers between Makkah and Madinah, our modern fleet guarantees smooth, timely, and air-conditioned travel under the supervision of vetted professional drivers.
offerings: Private VIP GMC Yukon Denali and luxury sedans for personal delegations
Modern 49-seater air-conditioned luxury tour buses with luggage compartments
Haramain High-Speed Train ticket reservation (business and economy classes)
Punctual airport pick-up and drop-off with meet-and-assist greeters
Comprehensive intercity transfers along comfortable divided expressways

title: Ziyarat Arrangements & Guidance
short: Spiritually uplifting, historically grounded visits to the sacred landmarks of Makkah and Madinah.
description: Walk where the beloved Prophet (peace be upon him) and his noble Companions walked. Our curated Ziyarat excursions are led by knowledgeable religious guides who narrate the profound historical context behind each mountain, valley, and sanctuary.
offerings: Makkah sacred sites: Jabal al-Noor, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, Jannat al-Mu'alla
Madinah sacred sites: Masjid Quba, Masjid al-Qiblatain, Mount Uhud & Martyrs' Cemetery, Jannat al-Baqi
Comfortable air-conditioned transport for all group and private Ziyarat
Flexible morning and late afternoon schedules to avoid midday heat
Accurate, respectful historical commentary aligned with Islamic tradition

description: As proudly stated on our brochure: 'We are here for you — Your comfort, our priority.' Pilgrims under Iconic Travel & Tours (GL #5247) never walk alone. Our dedicated group leaders and bilingual local staff are on standby 24 hours a day.
offerings: 24/7 direct telephone and WhatsApp hotline for every registered pilgrim
Dedicated group leader stationed at your hotel for immediate queries
Emergency medical liaison and prescription medicine assistance
Lost property tracking and official authority coordination
Elderly assistance, wheelchair facilitation, and specialized dietary guidance

short: Nutritious, high-quality morning buffets arranged for our groups to start each day energized.
description: Featured in our 2026 group campaigns, our breakfast program ensures pilgrims begin their day with nourishing meals and warm tea before embarking on prayers and Ziyarat. Timed comfortably between 06:30 AM and 10:00 AM on the Ground Floor restaurant.
offerings: Fresh international, continental, and traditional Pakistani/Arabian breakfast dishes
Designated dining hours (06:30 AM – 10:00 AM) aligned with post-Fajr schedules
Hygienic, comfortable dining hall environments on hotel premises

Complimentary hot beverages, fresh dates, and Zamzam water
